entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I'm calling about an order I received a few weeks ago. It's for the new VeloBand Pulse HR monitor.
Certainly. I can help with that. Could I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Of course. The name is Alex Chen, order number 774-B-910.
Thank you, Alex. I have your order right here. I see you received the VeloBand Pulse on December 15th. What can I do for you?
Right. So, I'd like to return it. I realize it's been almost a month, and I'm guessing it might be too late, but I was hoping we could work something out.
I understand. Before we get to that, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just a preference. The device works perfectly, but it's not comfortable on my wrist for long periods. I was hoping for a different fit.
Okay, thank you for clarifying that for me. Let me just take a moment to review our return policy for you.

Sure. And look, I get it if a full refund isn't possible. I understand there are probably policy rules around hygiene and sanitation for wearable tech. I'd be happy with store credit or even a discount on a different model.

I appreciate the offer, Alex, but that won't be necessary. I've just checked, and our company policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery. Since you received it 27 days ago, you're unfortunately outside that window for a full refund.
Oh! Seriously? I was completely prepared to negotiate. That's fantastic news. Thank you.

You're very welcome. I'm processing the return for you now. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just pack the item in its original box, apply the label, and drop it off. Your refund will be issued once it's received at our warehouse.
That's perfect. Simple enough. Thank you again for your help, Sarah.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Have a good one.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
